test_title: PYST 05: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 11 Dec 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

When will you play the musical instrument in the event?

options.text: When will the music instrument be played in the event?
When was the music instrument played by you in the event?
When will the music instrument be played by you in the event?
When should the music instrument be played by you in the event?

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "When will you play the musical instrument in the event?"
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "the musical instrument" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "will play" to "will be played" (future simple passive).
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "you."
 
• Ensure the time phrase "in the event" remains at the end of the sentence for clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"When will the music instrument be played by you in the event?"*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"When will the music instrument be played in the event?" – Missing the agent "by you."
 
• **Option 2: **"When was the music instrument played by you in the event?" – Incorrect tense (past simple passive).
 
• **Option 4: **"When should the music instrument be played by you in the event?" – Incorrect modal verb (should instead of will).
